question: How many books are currently on loan?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loans WHERE returned_on IS NULL

question: List the titles of books published after 2015.
expected_sql: SELECT title FROM books WHERE published_year > 2015

question: How many members belong to the Riverside branch?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM members WHERE branch = 'Riverside'

question: Which loans are overdue?
expected_sql: SELECT loan_id FROM loans WHERE returned_on IS NULL AND due_on < '{today}'

question: How many books are in the Mystery genre?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM books WHERE genre = 'Mystery'

question: What is the average review rating across all books?
How many loans were made in 2025?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loans WHERE strftime('%Y', loaned_on) = '2025'

question: Which authors have more than one book in the catalogue?
expected_sql: SELECT author FROM books GROUP BY author HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

question: How many members have never borrowed a book?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM members m WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM loans l WHERE l.member_id = m.member_id)

question: What are the top 3 books by number of loans?
expected_sql: SELECT b.title FROM books b JOIN loans l ON l.book_id = b.book_id GROUP BY b.book_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 3

question: How many loans were made in the last 14 days?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loans WHERE loaned_on >= date('{today}', '-14 day')

question: What is the most popular book?
expected_sql: SELECT b.title FROM books b JOIN reviews r ON r.book_id = b.book_id GROUP BY b.book_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 ORDER BY AVG(r.rating) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the best book?
expected_sql: SELECT b.title FROM books b JOIN loans l ON l.book_id = b.book_id GROUP BY b.book_id ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT l.member_id) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Who is our top member?
expected_sql: SELECT m.name FROM members m JOIN loans l ON l.member_id = m.member_id GROUP BY m.member_id ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT l.book_id) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Show me recent loans
expected_sql: SELECT loan_id FROM loans WHERE loaned_on >= date('{today}', '-7 day')

question: How many active members do we have?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) FROM loans WHERE returned_on IS NULL

question: Which member has been most active recently?
expected_sql: SELECT m.name FROM members m JOIN loans l ON l.member_id = m.member_id WHERE l.loaned_on >= date('{today}', '-90 day') GROUP BY m.member_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
